name: Harun al-Rashid
contribution: The fifth of the Abbasid caliphs, reigning from September 786 until his death in March 809.
legacy: This person established the legendary library Bayt al-Hikma in Baghdad in present-day Iraq, and during his rule Baghdad began to flourish as a world center of knowledge, culture and trade.

checks.lead: Abū Jaʿfar Hārūn ibn Muḥammad ar-Rashīd, (c. 763 or 766 – 24 March 809), famously known as Hārūn al-Rashīd, was the fifth of the Abbasid caliphs, reigning from September 786 until his death in March 809. His reign is traditionally regarded to be the beginning of the Islamic Golden Age. His epithet al-Rashid translates to "the Upright", or "the Rightly-Guided".
